|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (version 4 of 4). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. While an Imperial leader here, your total Force generation is +1. If opponent controls Bunker, place Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Ominous Rumors”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Ominous Rumors]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ominous Rumors (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “Deploy on Bunker; may immediately take any one [Endor] or [Death Star II] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-38d9f66">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/38d9f66 swccg-card-json commit 38d9f66] “Set 24 Errata” (13 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Perimeter Patrol is suspended.” was added before “If opponent controls Bunker”. Nothing else changed. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.

[Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-12dc019">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/12dc019 swccg-card-json commit 12dc019] “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark” (14 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The text after “Deploy on Bunker;” was rewritten: “may choose: Activate 1 Force for each opponent’s non-battleground location on table, or take Endor Shield into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
